title: Use Case

fields.label: Photo
fields.name: photo
fields.instructions: 16:10. Leave empty to show a placeholder box on the front end.

fields.label: Video
fields.name: video
fields.instructions: Optional. Takes priority over the photo above if both are set — muted, autoplay, loops. Never plays for a visitor with "reduce motion" turned on (the photo shows instead). Keep the file small — a compressed .mp4, a few seconds looping cleanly, no audio track needed since it's always muted.

fields.label: Industry
fields.name: industry
fields.instructions: Which industry this use case belongs to.

fields.label: Links to solution
fields.name: solution
fields.instructions: The use-case card links straight to this solution's page.

fields.label: Product
fields.name: product
fields.instructions: The specific product this use case's flip-card back face shows (name, description, photo, "Find out more" link all pull from this product, not the solution above). Optional — leave empty and the back face falls back to the linked solution's own name/dek/photo, same as before this field existed. Added 2026-08-24 for the homepage carousel's product-specific back faces (template-parts/home/use-cases.php).

fields.label: Featured in nav dropdown
fields.name: featured_in_nav
fields.instructions: Curates the mega menu's "Use Cases" dropdown and the homepage teaser row — one per industry is the usual pattern, not every use case.

description: PROJECT.md §4 CPT `use_case`. Migrated 2026-07-30 from the `industry` CPT's own use_cases repeater (see NOTES.md) to give this content a real, central admin list instead of editing it 7 posts at a time — post_title is the use-case label (e.g. "Loss Prevention"), no separate Name field needed since the CPT already supports Title.
